# Cua native ATIF fixture

Generated with `cua_bench.results.write_atif` from trycua/cua at
`2829e00b180dfb08ca5ff4cbd7c95e0a14ad3409` using invented reset, agent_step and evaluate rows.
The reset contains a generated one-pixel PNG; the Agent row has synthetic input/output usage 10/2
and the text `Fixture response`. No model, task dataset or desktop was used.

JSON whitespace is normalized to the repository format. The raw file and Orbit's imported copy both passed Harbor's original `TrajectoryValidator`,
including image existence/decoding checks. Standard ATIF fields and the upstream v1.8 version
are retained; Orbit adds provenance and replaces media paths with content-addressed local paths.
